layer_separation.U: Official forward Certified A-share membership. Authority: V2.7.31.
layer_separation.E: AI-Core evidence eligibility/materiality. Authority: Evidence Constitution V1.2; independent of price factors.
layer_separation.T: Technical/market features. May rank or describe eligible securities but cannot create U/E eligibility.
layer_separation.X: Execution/tradability/risk constraints. Separate from alpha evidence.

factor_families.hypothesis: Healthy medium-term trend structure contains information beyond short-horizon return strength.
candidate_features: economic_price relative to rolling moving-average levels
ordering and slope of medium/long moving averages
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: Do not copy lost TQ-STRUCT thresholds.

factor_families.hypothesis: Cross-sectional relative strength may contain continuation information in A shares.
candidate_features: cross-sectional percentile rank by signal date
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: RS/Ret20 cannot automatically promote a Setup.

factor_families.hypothesis: Trend continuation quality depends on avoiding extreme short-term extension/crowding.
candidate_features: distance from short/medium moving average normalized by rolling volatility
short-horizon acceleration relative to medium-horizon trend
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: No fixed overextension percentage becomes a hard gate before validation.

factor_families.hypothesis: Trend entries after volatility/range contraction may have better asymmetry than equally strong but expanded structures.
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: No VCP/ATR textbook threshold is imported as a rule.

factor_families.hypothesis: Liquidity affects implementation cost and reliability but is not itself evidence of AI-Core quality.
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: Liquidity cannot create alpha eligibility; it may only block or size execution after separate validation.

factor_families.hypothesis: Market regime may alter expected payoff or appropriate exposure without necessarily acting as a binary signal veto.
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: Market State is not a hard veto until incremental value is demonstrated.

factor_families.hypothesis: Within already-qualified AI-Core issuers, newer economically material evidence may alter opportunity ranking.
factor_families.prohibited_shortcut: Evidence freshness cannot be computed from future filings or replace Constitution V1.2 eligibility.

research_horizon_policy.exact_horizon_rule: Use joint A-share calendar; do not shift target date because a stock has a missing/suspended bar.
